Interface AssignmentRepository

All Superinterfaces:
org.springframework.data.repository.CrudRepository<Assignment, AssignmentId>, org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository<Assignment, AssignmentId>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListCrudRepository<Assignment, AssignmentId>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListPagingAndSortingRepository<Assignment, AssignmentId>, org.springframework.data.repository.PagingAndSortingRepository<Assignment, AssignmentId>, org.springframework.data.repository.query.QueryByExampleExecutor<Assignment>, org.springframework.data.repository.Repository<Assignment, AssignmentId>
@Repository public interface AssignmentRepository extends org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository<Assignment, AssignmentId>
Spring Data JPA repository for Assignment (assigned junction table). Owned by the task module. The ID type is the composite AssignmentId.
